answer: Sponsor-decay bond: newcomers join through a sponsor staking reputation and a 70-credit bond; vouchees carry a saffron seal, and reputation decays 5% for every epoch a vouchee is left to wander. Proven fakes burn the bond and bar the sponsor 20 epochs; a violet flag marks sponsors over 20 leaves. 1,000 fakes pay 95 each (70 bond, 25 fee), 95,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 55,000 loss. Honest agents pay once and get the bond back after 20 epochs.
